lang.description: De taal van deze teksten (voor het lang-attribuut van de pagina).

extDescription.message: Save the page, a link or selected text as a task on your own Tickory server.

menuSave.description: Het contextmenu (rechtsklik) op een pagina, link of selectie.

deviceName.description: De naam in de apparatenlijst van Tickory; $1 is de browser.

descFoundOn.description: In de beschrijving bij een opgeslagen link; $1 is het adres van de pagina.

titlePlaceholder.message: What do you want to do?

titleHint.message: Quick add (dates in Dutch): morgen, vrijdag 9:00, p1, #project, @label, !30m

readOnly.description: Een project in de keuzelijst dat je alleen leest; $1 is de naam.

savedPartly.message: Saved to $VALUE$, but a label or reminder could not be added.

notConnected.message: Not connected to your Tickory server yet.

reconnect.message: The connection to Tickory has expired or was revoked. Connect again.

signedInAs.description: $1 is de naam van de gebruiker, $2 de server.

serverHint.message: The address where you open Tickory in the browser. Without https only on your own network, for example http://192.168.1.10:8787.

permissionNote.message: The browser then asks whether the extension may use this address. The extension does not use any other website.

codeHint.message: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

pairHeading.message: Sign in with a pairing code

pairHint.message: Open Tickory in your browser, choose Settings › Account, password and devices › Create pairing code, and enter the code here. This also works if you only sign in with SSO.

passwordOff.message: On this server you only sign in with $VALUE$. Use a pairing code.
passwordOff.description: $1 is de naam van de inlogdienst.

orSeparator.description: Tussen inloggen met een wachtwoord en met een koppelcode.

connectedAs.description: $1 is de server, $2 de naam, $3 de gebruikersnaam.

connectedNext.message: Click the Tickory icon in the toolbar (or use the keyboard shortcut or the context menu) to save a page as a task.

logoutNote.message: Signing out signs this extension out in Tickory and removes the permission for the address.

logoutOffline.message: Signed out in the extension. The server could not be reached: also sign the extension out in Tickory (Account, Signed-in devices).

shortcutNote.message: Keyboard shortcut: $VALUE$. You can change it in your browser’s extension settings.

shortcutNone.message: No keyboard shortcut is set; you can set one in your browser’s extension settings.

privacyText.message: The extension only talks to your server and only sends something when you click Save: the title, the address of the page and what you selected. Nothing goes to anyone else, and the extension does not read pages on which you do not open it yourself.

privacyPermissions.message: Active tab: the title, address and selection of the page on which you open the extension. Scripts: only to read that selection. Context menu: Save to Tickory on a right-click. Storage: the address of your server and the token of this extension, only on this computer. Access to your server: asked only when you connect, only for that address.

errAddressEmpty.message: Enter the address of your server.

errAddressScheme.message: Use an address that starts with https:// (or http:// on your own network).

errAddressCredentials.message: Do not put a username or password in the address; you enter those below.

errAddressInvalid.message: This is not a valid address. Example: https://tasks.example.com

errInsecure.message: Without https your password and tasks travel unencrypted over the internet. Use https://, or http:// only for a server on your own network.

errPermission.message: The extension did not get permission for this address. Try again and choose Allow.

errNotTickory.message: There is no Tickory on this address (or a version without this feature).

errOfflineTryHttp.message: Is the address right? If your server runs without https on your own network, type http:// in front.

errOfflineTryHttps.message: Is the address right, and can this computer reach your server?

errTimeout.message: Tickory does not respond. Try again in a moment.

errPasswordOff.message: Signing in with a password is turned off on this server. Use a pairing code.

errCode.message: The code is incorrect (or has already been used).

errChallenge.message: This sign-in attempt has expired. Sign in again with your password.

errPairCode.message: This pairing code is unknown, expired or already used. Create a new one in Tickory.

errPairCodeFormat.message: A pairing code has 16 characters, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS.

errBusy.message: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.

errUnauthorized.message: The connection to Tickory has expired or was revoked. Connect again.

errForbidden.message: You can only read this project. Choose another project.

errNotFound.message: This project (or label) no longer exists. Choose another project.

errLimit.message: Nothing more fits: a limit of the server has been reached.

errInvalidTask.message: The server did not accept this task. Change the title or description and try again.

errTooLarge.message: The task is too large. Make the description shorter.

errServer.message: The server returned an error. Try again later.

errTooMany.message: Too many attempts. Try again in $VALUE$ minutes.

errTooManyOne.message: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
